title: Against curious decree-disputes; creation as alphabet of revelation
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): This stands as ye alphabet belonging toward every notion plus action. but all things stand as to be sought out from ye heavenly Fathers Apocalypse, that same which Genesis 1:1 God in ye beginning plus before all things made known through ye act belonging toward CREATION belonging toward these heavens plus this earth, that same which certainly stands as ye revelation belonging toward revelations, plus by means belonging toward its power embraces all ye rest — nothing here can flesh plus blood. Romans 11:33-34. without scrupulosity, we must think plus speak concerning ye Lords counsels plus ways — Isaiah 55; — but soberly plus with great religion. reprobation, providence, as some years past happened, alas, in neighboring Belgium — lest we tear plus lacerate still more ye German churches already long enough divided by means belonging toward dangerous altercations concerning predestination. whose consideration, as it stands as hard plus abstruse, so will be undertaken most well plus safely belonging toward all a posteriori in their own places: — at length indeed plus learnedly there stand as commonly inserted here dogmas concerning divine decrees plus counsels.
pass_b_english: At length indeed and learnedly there are commonly inserted here dogmas concerning divine decrees and counsels, whose consideration, as it is hard and abstruse, so will be undertaken most well and safely of all a posteriori in their own places: lest we tear and lacerate still more the German churches already long enough divided by dangerous altercations concerning predestination, reprobation, providence, as some years past happened, alas, in neighboring Belgium.

But soberly and with great religion, without scrupulosity, we must think and speak concerning the Lords counsels and ways — Isaiah 55; Romans 11:33-34. Nothing here can flesh and blood, but all things are to be sought from the heavenly Fathers Apocalypse, which Genesis 1:1 God in the beginning and before all things made known through the act of CREATION of these heavens and this earth, which certainly is the revelation of revelations, and by its power embraces all the rest. This is the alphabet of every notion and action.
source_text: Prolixe quidem et erudite hic inseruntur vulgo dogmata de divinis decretis et consiliis, quorum consideratio, ut ardua et abstrusa est, ita a posteriori suis locis omnium optime et tutissime suscipietur: ne ecclesias Germanicas satis jam diu divulsas periculosis altercationibus de praedestinatione, reprobatione, providentia magis atque magis divellamus, atque dilaceremus, ut annis aliquot praeteritis in vicino nobis Belgio, pro dolor, accidit. Sobrie vero et magna cum religione, sine scrupulositate, de consiliis et viis Domini cogitandum et loquendum est nobis — Isa. LV; Rom. XI.33-34. Nihil hic caro et sanguis potest, sed omnia ex Apocalypsi Patris caelestis petenda sunt, quae Gen. I.1 Deus in principio et ante omnia patefecit per actum CREATIONIS horum caelorum et hujus terrae, quae certe revelatio revelationum est, et virtute sua omnes reliquas complectitur. Hoc est alphabetum omnis notionis et actionis.
